title: A phase runs its ready tasks as waves, and task scopes carry their companions
description: F600 (high) and F599 (med) from the danuvia testbed. Design, prior art, roles and decisions: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-10-09-f600-f599-waves-design.md (D1 unset width = 1 and init writes auto; D3 re-gate only on path overlap; D7 the plan-gate binding is agent-written).
desiredOutcome: A phase runs its ready disjoint tasks concurrently, each gated in its own worktree and integrated serially onto the phase tree with conflicting or undeclared overlaps refused by name, width 1 reproduces 3.2.0 exactly, and a task's scope carries the dependency, locale and runner-config files its change cannot avoid.

tasks.title: wave selection and overlap classification are pure functions over the plan
tasks.description: F600 design A1 (quality-gates-internal plans/2026-10-09-f600-f599-waves-design.md, section 4.1 step 1). select(tasks, width) and overlap(a, b) over task dicts, through _task_outputs.covers; lockfiles are non-mergeable. The caller passes ready tasks in id order.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test__wave.py: two disjoint ready tasks at width 2 make one wave; width 1 is id order one at a time; empty files runs alone; a directory overlaps its subpath; an overlap names both tasks; a lockfile overlap is non-mergeable

outcome.technical: Reviewed the already-applied diff (_wave.py select/overlap/is_non_mergeable via _task_outputs.covers, test__wave w1-w7c, _deps LAYERS entry, guide tree line/section, test__output lists). Since P122 _wave renders at L3 (below _task_outputs L2), so I corrected the stale LAYERS comment that said L2/L1, and regenerated the guide module-map fence from _deps.py --render (now includes '_wave -> _output, _task_outputs' under L3 and _machine_paths at L1). Ran: test__wave --selftest 14/14, test__deps 307/307, test__output 225/225 (all pass), ruff check plugins/audit tools exit 0. Full sweep/vermin not run (own-tests reading).
outcome.descriptive: Wave selection and overlap classification are pure, tested functions; layer table and guide map current.
